title: Frontier exploration D: SAT and Hensel-cocycle follow-ups null
question: Frontier D (ECDLP-37) follow-ups, all NULL: (1) structure-aware SAT encodings (x-only Montgomery ladder, native XOR via CryptoMiniSat) are worse than the affine encoding (affine conflict exponents 1.27 Glucose4, 1.47 CaDiCaL; ladder unsolved within 120 s at n = 5-7); (2) Hensel-section cocycle: exact identity g(kP) = k g(P) − N S_k with Birkhoff sum S_k verified on 8 curves (p <= 30011), but p^2/p^3 digits show no low linear complexity, no P-recursive or low-degree relation, no k mod m dependence (spectral flag was a null-model artefact; symmetry-respecting null |z| <= 2.6, post hoc); (3) lift-variation idea killed (4 unknowns vs 3 equations; lift-dependent part not low-degree).
